title: ITSP.10.171 least-functionality reviews and removals need effective evidence
remediation: The sponsor infrastructure owner defines mission-essential capabilities and the restricted functions, ports, protocols, connections and services. Compare operating settings to this list and sample a periodic review that identified and disabled or removed an unnecessary or nonsecure item. The sponsor confirms the assessed ITSP.10.171 supplementary boundary and accountable owner.

milestones.title: Collect approved functionality and restrictions, effective settings and a periodic review with follow-up evidence
